engine_build_note: SHA-256 of the local /usr/local/bin/stockfish executable. A canonical run aborts unless the launched binary hashes to this exact value. SF18 embeds both NNUE nets, so the executable hash transitively pins the network content.
eval_file_sha256_note: Full SHA-256 of each official NNUE artifact, fetched once from data.stockfishchess.org/nn and verified: the content hash's first 12 hex equal the content-addressed filename. eval_file_id/eval_file_small_id carry <filename>:<full-64-hex-sha256>.
